description: Pull DeFi metrics from DefiLlama's public APIs. Choose a `mode`, optionally narrow by `chain` / `protocolSlug` / `category` / `stablecoin filters` / `URL`, and run.

bridgeName.description: Bridge identifier from the bridges list.
bridgeName.title: Bridge name (mode=bridgeByName)

category.description: Filter records by DefiLlama category (e.g. `Lending`, `Dexes`, `Liquid Staking`, `Yield Aggregator`, `Bridge`, `CDP`, `Yield`, `Derivatives`, `Cross Chain`).
category.sectionDescription: Optional filters applied after fetch: text search, chain, category, TVL/APY floors, and yield-only options.
category.title: Category filter (protocols / DEX / lending / fees)

chain.description: Chain name as DefiLlama uses it. Required for `historicalChainTvl`; also filters protocols, chains, stablecoins, yields, DEX, lending, fees, and bridges by chain where the source exposes it. Use the dropdown for top chains, OR paste an exact chain name from the chains list (case-sensitive — DefiLlama uses `Ethereum`, `BSC`, etc.).
chain.title: Chain (mode=historicalChainTvl, optional filter)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on records emitted in this run. Combine with `offset` to page through a long result set. Example: `100`.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Pagination, sorting, and hard output caps.
maxItems.title: Max items (page size)

minApy.description: Drop yield pools whose total APY is below this percentage. Applies to `mode=yields` only.
minApy.title: Minimum APY % (mode=yields)

minTvlUsd.description: Drop records with TVL below this threshold (USD).
minTvlUsd.title: Minimum TVL in USD (protocols / chains / yields / lending)

enumTitles: Protocols — list of all protocols with current TVL
By protocol — historical TVL + breakdown for one protocol
TVL — current TVL by chain (all chains)
Historical chain TVL — daily TVL series for one chain
Stablecoins — list with circulating supplies & breakdowns
Stablecoin chains — circulating per chain across all stablecoins
Yields by pool — historical APY for one pool
DEX volumes — DEX overview / per-protocol volumes
DEX by protocol — historical volume for one DEX
Lending by protocol — historical lending for one protocol
Bridge by name — historical bridge volume
Current prices — current token prices by coingecko/chain id
By URL — paste a defillama.com URL, auto-detect mode
mode.title: Mode

offset.description: Skip this many records after filtering and sorting, then emit up to `maxItems`. Page 2 with `maxItems=100` means `offset=100`.
offset.title: Pagination offset

poolId.description: DefiLlama yield pool UUID (visible in the pool URL on yields.llama.fi).
poolId.title: Pool ID (mode=yieldsByPool)

protocolSlug.description: DefiLlama protocol slug — visible in the URL on defillama.com (e.g. `aave`, `lido`, `uniswap`, `curve-dex`). Example: `aave`.
protocolSlug.sectionDescription: Mode-specific identifiers: protocol slug, chain name, stablecoin / pool / bridge / token IDs, or a defillama.com URL.
protocolSlug.title: Protocol slug (mode=byProtocol / dexByProtocol / lendingByProtocol)

searchQuery.description: Case-insensitive text match on name, symbol, or project — e.g. `aave`, `uniswap`, `USDC`.
searchQuery.title: Name search (any list mode)

sortBy.description: Sort matching records before applying `offset` and `maxItems`. Leave empty to keep the source order.
sortBy.title: Sort by

sortOrder.description: Direction used when `sortBy` is set. Records with a missing sort value are placed last.
sortOrder.title: Sort direction

stablecoinId.description: DefiLlama stablecoin ID (e.g. `1` = USDT, `2` = USDC). See `mode=stablecoins` to enumerate.
stablecoinId.title: Stablecoin ID (mode=stablecoinPrices)

stablecoinIncludePrices.description: When true, the stablecoins endpoint includes current price data per asset.
stablecoinIncludePrices.title: Include current prices (mode=stablecoins)

tokenIds.description: List of token IDs in DefiLlama format: `coingecko:bitcoin`, `ethereum:0x...`, `bsc:0x...`. Up to 100 per call.
tokenIds.title: Token IDs (mode=currentPrices)

url.description: Any defillama.com URL — auto-detected. Examples: defillama.com/protocol/aave , defillama.com/chain/Ethereum , stablecoins.llama.fi (homepage → top stablecoins).
url.title: URL (mode=byUrl)

yieldProject.description: Only keep yield pools from projects whose slug contains this text, e.g. `aave`, `lido`, `curve`.
yieldProject.title: Yield project filter (mode=yields)

yieldStablecoinOnly.description: Keep only yield pools where DefiLlama marks the underlying asset as a stablecoin.
yieldStablecoinOnly.title: Stablecoin pools only (mode=yields)

title: DefiLlama Scraper Input
